name: Controlling Your Anger
overview: Scripture teaches that controlling anger is essential for godly living, emphasizing patience and self-control as marks of wisdom and strength. Believers are urged to cease from anger and avoid wrath, recognizing that quick temper leads to folly, while a gentle response can defuse conflict. True strength is shown by ruling one’s spirit rather than conquering external battles, and treating others as we wish to be treated fosters peace. Additionally, the call to avoid judgment reminds us to examine our own hearts before condemning others.
